start: The panel open on a device signed in as an owner; this device is then signed out by the owner himself on another device ("Sign out other devices"), another owner, or MettleUp

steps.action: Carry on using the panel (open a page or save something)
user_sees: The gym closes and the welcome page shows "You were signed out of this gym. Ask the gym owner for a new code. If you are the owner, make one on a device where you are signed in."
must_not: The gym still readable or saving after the sign-out
A blank page or an error code with no reason
The words for a removed person

steps.action: Sign in again with a code made on the other device
user_sees: The gym opens; the notice is gone
must_not: The old notice still on the page after signing in

start: The panel open on a device signed in as an owner; another owner removes this owner from the gym

steps.action: Carry on using the panel
user_sees: The welcome page with "You no longer have access to this gym. Talk to the gym owner."
must_not: "Ask the gym owner for a new code" left on the page for a person who cannot come back with a code
The gym's records still on the device

start: Staff & sign-in as an owner; the person signs out by choice

steps.action: Tap "Sign out of this device", then "Sign out"
user_sees: The welcome page with "You are signed out of this device."
must_not: The "You were signed out of this gym…" words for a sign-out the person chose

start: A device of an owner that was removed from the gym, with no internet at the moment the panel notices

steps.action: Open the panel with no internet, then get the internet back
user_sees: At least the signed-out words; the removed words once the reason can be asked
must_not: The removed person left for good with words that tell them to ask for a new code
The page hanging while the reason is asked

steps.action: Refresh the welcome page
user_sees: The welcome page
must_not: The reason gone after a refresh with nothing said at all: check what is shown

start: Welcome page showing a signed-out notice for an owner

steps.action: Sign in again
user_sees: The gym; no notice
must_not: The notice carried into the gym or shown at the next sign-out by choice

steps.action: Be signed out a second time from another device
user_sees: The same signed-out words again, once
must_not: Two notices, or none the second time

steps.action: With the panel open in two tabs, get signed out
user_sees: Both tabs end on the welcome page
must_not: One tab still inside the gym
The second tab showing no reason at all: check what it shows

start: Welcome page after an owner was signed out or removed

steps.action: Look at the page and at what is left on the device
user_sees: Only the reason line and the sign-in form
must_not: The gym's name, members or payments still readable on the device after a removal
Saved-but-unsent items thrown away without a word
The words naming who signed the person out
